content.definition: Method of revenue recognition where gross profit recognized proportionately as cash collected (not at point of sale)
content.when_allowed: Only when collection is highly uncertain and reasonable basis for estimating collectibility doesn't exist (NOT preferred under GAAP)
content.asc_606_impact: ASC 606 eliminated most uses. Generally recognize revenue at point of sale even if payment over time. Installment method limited to specific situations.
content.key_formula: Gross profit % = (Sales price - Cost) / Sales price. Gross profit recognized = Cash collected × Gross profit %

sale.entry: DR Installment AR, DR COGS, CR Inventory, CR Deferred Gross Profit (plug)
sale.deferred_gp: Deferred GP = Sales price - Cost = Total gross profit to be recognized over time

collection.entry: DR Cash, CR Installment AR. DR Deferred Gross Profit, CR Realized Gross Profit (revenue)

calculation_example.facts: Sell equipment for $100K (cost $60K). Collect $30K Year 1, $40K Year 2, $30K Year 3.

year_1.sale: DR Installment AR $100K, DR COGS $60K, CR Inventory $60K, CR Deferred GP $40K
year_1.collection: DR Cash $30K, CR Installment AR $30K. DR Deferred GP $12K (40% × $30K), CR Realized GP $12K

year_2.collection: DR Cash $40K, CR Installment AR $40K. DR Deferred GP $16K (40% × $40K), CR Realized GP $16K

year_3.collection: DR Cash $30K, CR Installment AR $30K. DR Deferred GP $12K (40% × $30K), CR Realized GP $12K

balance_sheet_presentation.installment_ar: Current and non-current portions based on collection schedule
balance_sheet_presentation.deferred_gp: Contra-account to Installment AR (reduces net AR)

default_and_repossession.if_buyer_defaults: Repossess asset, cancel remaining AR and deferred GP, recognize gain/loss
default_and_repossession.calculation: FV of repossessed asset - Net AR (AR - Deferred GP) = Gain or Loss
default_and_repossession.example: AR balance $40K, Deferred GP $16K, Net AR $24K. Repossess asset FV $30K. Gain = $30K - $24K = $6K.

interest_on_installment_sales.if_stated_interest: Record interest revenue separately from gross profit
interest_on_installment_sales.if_imputed_interest: If no stated interest or unrealistic rate, impute interest (discount note to PV, recognize interest over time)

cost_recovery_method.even_more_conservative: Recognize NO profit until ALL cost recovered. Then recognize remaining collections as profit.
cost_recovery_method.when_used: When collection even more uncertain than installment method
cost_recovery_method.example: Sell for $100K, cost $60K. Collect $60K Year 1, $40K Year 2. Year 1: $0 profit (still recovering cost). Year 2: $40K profit (all cost recovered).

tax_considerations.tax_method: Installment method may be used for tax purposes even if not used for books
tax_considerations.book_tax_difference: Creates temporary difference (deferred tax) if book uses full accrual but tax uses installment

cpa_exam_tips: Installment method: Recognize GP = Cash collected × GP %
Deferred GP = Contra to Installment AR (reduces net AR)
Default: Gain/Loss = FV repossessed - Net AR (AR - Deferred GP)
Cost recovery: NO profit until cost fully recovered, then all profit
ASC 606: Installment method rarely used under current GAAP (recognize at point of sale)

calculation_steps: 2. Each period: Realized GP = Cash collected × GP %
3. Deferred GP reduces by amount realized each period
default_calculation: 1. Net AR = Installment AR - Deferred GP
2. Gain/Loss = FV of repossessed asset - Net AR
common_mistakes: Using cost % instead of GP % (GP % = profit/sales, not cost/sales)
Forgetting to reduce deferred GP as cash collected
Not treating deferred GP as contra-account to AR
Calculating default gain/loss using gross AR instead of net AR

key_points: Installment method: Recognize gross profit proportionately as cash collected
GP % = (Sales - Cost) / Sales. Realized GP = Cash collected × GP %
Deferred GP = Contra to Installment AR
Default: Gain/Loss = FV repossessed - Net AR (AR - Deferred GP)
Cost recovery: NO profit until cost recovered, then all profit
Limited use under ASC 606 (recognize revenue at point of sale generally)
